import java.util.*;

public class Main {
    static final int mod = 1000000007;
    static int[] p1 = new int[(1 << 20) + 5];
    static int[] p2 = new int[(1 << 20) + 5];
    static int[] h = new int[10 * 10 * 10]; // flattened 3D for simplicity
    static boolean[][] flag = new boolean[10][10];
    static int[][] a = new int[10][10];
    static int[][][] H = new int[10][10][10]; // renamed for clarity
    static int n, lim, ans;
    static int totalH;
    static int[] indexH = new int[20]; // each 3-comb index
    static int[] hIndex = new int[6 + 1]; // to hold mapping of h combos
    static int[] permBuffer = {0, 1, 2};
    
    static int fpow(int x, int y) {
        int res = 1;
        while (y > 0) {
            if ((y & 1) == 1) res = (int)((long)res * x % mod);
            x = (int)((long) x * x % mod);
            y >>= 1;
        }
        return res;
    }

    static int inv(int x) {
        return fpow(x, mod - 2);
    }

    static boolean check(int x, int y, int z) {
        int[] aArr = {x, y, z};
        do {
            if (flag[aArr[permBuffer[0]]][1] && flag[aArr[permBuffer[1]]][2] && flag[aArr[permBuffer[2]]][3]) {
                return true;
            }
        } while (nextPermutation(permBuffer));
        return false;
    }

    static boolean nextPermutation(int[] array) {
        int i = array.length - 2;
        while (i >= 0 && array[i] >= array[i + 1])
            i--;
        if (i < 0)
            return false;
        int j = array.length - 1;
        while (array[j] <= array[i])
            j--;
        swap(array, i, j);
        int left = i + 1, right = array.length - 1;
        while (left < right) {
            swap(array, left, right);
            left++;
            right--;
        }
        return true;
    }

    static void swap(int[] arr, int i, int j) {
        int tmp = arr[i];
        arr[i] = arr[j];
        arr[j] = tmp;
    }

    static void dfs1(int P, int x, int y) {
        if (x == 7 && y == 1) {
            int sta = 0;
            for (int i = 1; i <= 6; i++)
                for (int j = i + 1; j <= 6; j++)
                    for (int k = j + 1; k <= 6; k++)
                        if (check(i, j, k)) {
                            int xx = 1;
                            while (xx == i || xx == j || xx == k) xx++;
                            int yy = xx + 1;
                            while (yy == i || yy == j || yy == k) yy++;
                            int zz = yy + 1;
                            while (zz == i || zz == j || zz == k) zz++;
                            sta |= H[xx][yy][zz];
                        }
            p1[sta] = (p1[sta] + P) % mod;
            return;
        }
        flag[x][y] = true;
        if (y == 3) {
            dfs1((int)((long) P * a[x][y] % mod), x + 1, 1);
        } else {
            dfs1((int)((long) P * a[x][y] % mod), x, y + 1);
        }
        flag[x][y] = false;
        if (y == 3) {
            dfs1((int)((long) P * (mod + 1 - a[x][y]) % mod), x + 1, 1);
        } else {
            dfs1((int)((long) P * (mod + 1 - a[x][y]) % mod), x, y + 1);
        }
    }

    static void dfs2(int P, int x, int y) {
        if (x == 7 && y == 4) {
            int sta = 0;
            for (int i = 1; i <= 6; i++)
                for (int j = i + 1; j <= 6; j++)
                    for (int k = j + 1; k <= 6; k++)
                        if (check(i, j, k))
                            sta |= H[i][j][k];
            p2[sta] = (p2[sta] + P) % mod;
            ans = (ans + (int)((long) p1[lim ^ sta] * P % mod)) % mod;
            return;
        }
        flag[x][y - 3] = true;
        if (y == 6) {
            dfs2((int)((long) P * a[x][y] % mod), x + 1, 4);
        } else {
            dfs2((int)((long) P * a[x][y] % mod), x, y + 1);
        }
        flag[x][y - 3] = false;
        if (y == 6) {
            dfs2((int)((long) P * (mod + 1 - a[x][y]) % mod), x + 1, 4);
        } else {
            dfs2((int)((long) P * (mod + 1 - a[x][y]) % mod), x, y + 1);
        }
    }

    public static void main(String[] args) {
        Scanner sc = new Scanner(System.in);
        n = sc.nextInt();
        for (int i = 1; i <= n; i++) {
            for (int j = 1; j <= n; j++) {
                int val = sc.nextInt();
                a[i][j] = (int)((long) val * inv(100) % mod);
            }
        }
        for (int i = n + 1; i <= 6; i++)
            a[i][i] = 1;
        totalH = 0;
        for (int i = 1; i <= 6; i++) {
            for (int j = i + 1; j <= 6; j++) {
                for (int k = j + 1; k <= 6; k++) {
                    H[i][j][k] = 1 << totalH++;
                }
            }
        }
        dfs1(1, 1, 1);
        lim = (1 << 20) - 1;

        // subset sum over p1
        for (int i = 0; i < 20; i++) {
            for (int j = 0; j <= lim; j++) {
                if (((j >> i) & 1) != 0) {
                    p1[j] = (p1[j] + p1[j ^ (1 << i)]) % mod;
                }
            }
        }
        dfs2(1, 1, 4);
        ans = (mod + 1 - ans) % mod;
        System.out.println(ans);
        sc.close();
    }
}
